scope: Deterministic CPU ReplayData-to-TargetFrame sampling; synthetic fixtures, no running timeline, HTTP session or IsaacSim/media acceptance

tests.backend_command: env -u PYTHONPATH -u PYTHONHOME PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -o addopts= -q

sampling_probe.scope: CPU source-to-TargetFrame sampling only; no IsaacSim/video/final replay performance

sampler_metadata.sampling: per-channel linear / explicitly wrapped shortest-path interpolation
sampler_metadata.wrapped_lift_provenance: Lift uses the contiguous valid source-run prefix; source_indices identify current raw endpoints, not an expanded copy of the prefix.
sampler_metadata.missing_joint_policy: last valid source at or before query, invalid quality; leading fallback zero
sampler_metadata.chassis_policy: already world xy/yaw; unavailable is None; worker must preserve initial z/roll/pitch

virtual_wheels.initial_reference: Configured visual angle at the start of the log; not an observed absolute wheel angle.
limitations: Visual center-distance approximation ignores wheel-specific steering and offsets, including during arcs.
Wrapped yaw cannot recover unknown full turns between source samples.
Missing or unsupported motion makes all subsequent cumulative roll unavailable; integration never restarts.
virtual_wheels.source_indices_semantics: Indices into data.sample_times_s identify only the current integration interval endpoints.

review.fix: Check every chassis source edge over each virtual integration interval using an invalid-edge prefix; an unrelated union timestamp cannot change whether a forbidden gap is crossed

boundaries: Virtual wheels disabled by default; enabling requires explicit radius and all three joint signs
Synthetic radius/sign values in tests are not confirmed hardware parameters
Forward center-distance approximation ignores wheel-specific steering/offsets; lateral/pure rotation/unknown intervals invalidate cumulative estimates from that point onward
Raw chassis-axis imports still require aligned grids; sampler consumes normalized world coordinates
World transformation is applied only at import; future worker must implement initial z/roll/pitch and unavailable-pose policy
Prepared target identity is not rendered or presented-frame evidence
No global resampling grid and no mutation of archived source values or hashes
One small CPU benchmark does not establish simulation, media, long-duration or large-file performance
